verdict.rationale: Jitsu is a Segment-alternative CDP with profiles, so AI-built audience segments are a fair question for this kind of product, but the evidence pack never mentions a natural-language segment builder or any audience or segment definitions. Its MCP server lets external agents manage destinations, streams, Live Events and Functions, and Profile Builder builds profiles from traits. These are adjacent capabilities and developer building blocks, not AI-generated, schema-grounded segment definitions for review.
